activities.title: The Sky's the Limit Neon Tunnel
activities.description: Walk through Michael Hayden's iconic 745-foot kinetic neon light installation set to a stylized version of Rhapsody in Blue.

activities.title: Restored WWII F4F-3 Wildcat
activities.description: See an authentic, beautifully restored World War II fighter plane identical to the one flown by the airport's namesake, Butch O'Hare.

activities.title: Tortas Frontera
activities.description: Consistently rated one of the best airport restaurants in America. Grab an incredible griddle-baked Mexican sandwich by Chef Rick Bayless.

activities.title: Field Museum Store Brachiosaurus
activities.description: Check out the massive, 72-foot-long Brachiosaurus skeleton model towering over the terminal concourse.
